title: Human Senses
description: The human senses, including the classic five plus balance, proprioception, and more.

results.name: Sight (vision)
results.description: Detection of light, color, and motion to perceive the visual world.

results.name: Hearing (audition)
results.description: Detection of sound waves as vibrations in the air.

results.name: Smell (olfaction)
results.description: Detection of airborne chemical molecules to perceive odors.

results.name: Taste (gustation)
results.description: Detection of dissolved chemicals to perceive sweet, sour, salty, bitter, and umami.

results.name: Touch (tactition)
results.description: Detection of pressure, vibration, and texture through the skin.

results.name: Balance (equilibrioception)
results.organ: Vestibular system of the inner ear
results.description: Sense of body orientation, acceleration, and equilibrium.

results.name: Proprioception
results.description: Awareness of the position and movement of the body's parts.

results.name: Temperature (thermoception)
results.description: Detection of heat and cold through thermoreceptors.

results.name: Pain (nociception)
results.description: Detection of harmful or damaging stimuli to protect the body.
